description: T648 frozen baseline and G1752 incrementally accepted per-batch label ledger. No automated updater installed yet.

updatePolicy.entryRule: Only after all 24 stories in the batch pass the required G story and tag-content review; a draft or partial batch is never accepted.
updatePolicy.deduplication: Reject duplicate batchId, story IDs or source SHA mismatch. Do not append an already accepted batch.
updatePolicy.counting: At most one occurrence per distinct G01..G11 tag per story; multiple valid tags allowed.
updatePolicy.sourceOfTruth: gAccepted.acceptedBatches has per-story final tag list; totals and percentages must be recomputed from T frozen baseline plus accepted batches.
updatePolicy.onStoryRevision: If a prior accepted story must be formally revised, replace the affected existing batch entry after re-approval and recompute (never add the revised story a second time).
updatePolicy.branchPromotion: The accepted batch record must refer to the correct approved revision and be committed with the corresponding authorized V1 batch promotion.
updatePolicy.planning: Read this JSON before each 24-story batch; use overall gap as directional guidance, not individual G/T quota.
updatePolicy.invariants: 0<=batchCount<=73, storyCount=batchCount*24, count of accepted unique story IDs=storyCount, sum(gAccepted.tagCounts)=gAccepted.labelOccurrenceCount, combined.tagCounts=tBaseline.tagCounts+gAccepted.tagCounts, sum(combined.tagCounts)=combined.labelOccurrenceCount, percentages=100*tagCount/combined.labelOccurrenceCount.
